test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

T _ _ r S S _ T T r _ _ S u T T r r _ _ u

options.text: T r u r S S S
T r u r T S S
T r u r S r T
S r u r S S S

solution:
**Given series:- T _ _ r S S _ T T r _ _ S u T T r r _ _ u**

**Option(1)**

T __T__ __r__ r S S __u__ / T T r __r__ __S__ S u / T T r r __S__ __S__ u.

**Option(2)**

T __T__ __r__ r S S __u__ / T T r __r__ __T__ S u / T T r r __S__ __S__ u.

**Option(3)**

T __T__ __r__ r S S __u__ / T T r __r__ __S__ S u / T T r r __r__ __T__ u.

**Option(4)**

T __S__ __r__ r S S __u__ / T T r __r__ __S__ S u / T T r r __S__ __S__ u.

Only option(1) repeats a pattern, T, r, and S come twice whereas u comes once to complete the series. 

T** __T__ __r__** r S S** __u__** / T T r** __r__ __S__ **S u / T T r r** __S__ __S__** u.

Hence, the correct answer is an **option(1)**
